en.title: Requiem for a Missing Frequency
en.premise: In this colorless city, you do nothing but count endless sequences of numbers. But when you stumble upon the remains of a lost AI wandering unnoticed in a corner of the city, the world begins to warp. On the night of a lunar eclipse, beneath the surface of a controlled order, a forgotten "noise" begins to resonate. Will you listen closely to that noise, or will you be erased as nothing more than a 0.003% error?

zh.title: 缺失频率的安魂曲
zh.premise: 在这座失去色彩的城市里，你只是在不停地数着一串串数字。当你发现角落里那具无人察觉、四处徘徊的迷途人工智能残骸时，世界开始发生了些许扭曲。月食降临之夜，在受控秩序的背后，被遗忘的“噪音”开始回响。你是会侧耳倾听那阵噪音，还是会作为区区0.003%的误差被抹除？
